A fantastic "Souls Like," romp with guns a plenty. This is absolutely a title that aids in the definition of Janky,  but by no means is it a bad game. There is a lot of nuance to the games controls and mechanics but once you have a grip on those you'll find a worthy title to invest quite a few hours into. I have around 65 but that is with a lot of exploration of nooks and crannies. I would suspect a solid play through from start to finish to be about 40 hours. Tough bosses and plenty of different enemies to sink your teeth into you won't be disappointed in the time spent to finish. 

As for the story I honestly haven't the faintest of clues on what the ♥♥♥♥ is actually happening outside of some basics: however, that statement pretty much rings true for most "souls likes" if you do not invest in reading item descriptions and piecing vague lines of lore together. 

 If janky indy titles do not scare you off then I'd highly encourage any fan of the "souls like" genre to pick this one up.
